description: Batch Normalization forward + backward benchmark using cuDNN (NVIDIA) or MIOpen (AMD). Spatial mode: per-channel normalization. Default: N=64, C=256, H=W=56 (NCHW, FP32). Reports effective bandwidth in GB/s.

scaling_param.name: spatial_dim
scaling_param.description: Spatial dimension of the input tensor (H=W); controls total element count N*C*H*W

non_scaling_params.name: warmup
non_scaling_params.description: Number of warmup iterations before timing

non_scaling_params.name: iters
non_scaling_params.description: Number of timed iterations for averaging
